rationale: Neither candidate surfaces the specific ground-truth concerns (the unsupported 'fast' quality tier falling through silently, or the provided_fields gating inconsistency in the two serving files) — most of which read as already resolved earlier in the PR's history — so recall is low for both, with Y getting slight extra credit for directly re-verifying the exact serving_video.py/serving_video_output_stream.py lines the ground truth flagged. X offers deeper, more concretely actionable major findings (specific proposed code fixes for a partial-install failure and disable() target correctness) in a clean triage format, and treats the ambiguous CI-gate signal with appropriate hedging. Y is procedurally rigorous with validated/refuted evidence tags and catches a legitimate pytest-marker CI-deselection issue, but elevates the unattributed CI failure to its top 'major' finding while admitting it can't confirm causation, and its verbose scan-report format is harder to act on.
